_comment: Highest-priority policy of the three — privileged admin roles (Global Admin, Privileged Role Admin, Security Admin) must come from an Intune-compliant, hybrid-Azure-AD-joined device. This directly closes the 'privileged role assignment from an untrusted device' gap this project's own KQL detections (Phase 3) look for.
displayName: CA003 - Require Compliant Device for Privileged Roles

users._roles_comment: Global Administrator, Privileged Role Administrator, Security Administrator role template IDs — Microsoft's fixed, documented GUIDs for these built-in roles, not arbitrary values

_deployment_note: operator: AND (not OR like CA001) is deliberate here — for privileged roles, both MFA and a compliant device are required together, not either/or. This is a stricter bar than the baseline MFA policy on purpose.
